title: Expanded networking billing for OpenSharing SecureConnect
body:
Databricks will be expanding networking billing for OpenSharing SecureConnect. Today, data providers are billed for data transfer (egress) when recipients access shared data through SecureConnect. Additional charge types and access scenarios, including charges billed to recipients, are planned.

The following table summarizes the planned charges, who is billed, and how each applies across access scenarios:

Charge type

Status

Cross-region or cross-cloud

Same-region (classic or open recipient)

Same-region (serverless recipient)

Data transfer

Available today

Bill to provider

Not applicable ¹

Private Connectivity ²

Coming soon

Bill to provider

Bill to provider

Bill to recipient

Public Connectivity

Coming soon

Bill to recipient

Not applicable ³

Not applicable ⁴

¹ Data transfer (egress) does not apply when the recipient is in the same region as the provider.² Applies only if the provider configures private connectivity by attaching a network connectivity configuration (NCC) to the metastore.³ Databricks does not bill this charge. If recipients on classic compute or open recipients reach storage over the public network, their own cloud provider might bill them for network address translation (NAT) directly.⁴ Same-region serverless recipients read from storage directly rather than through the managed proxy.

For rates, see [Data transfer and connectivity pricing](https://www.databricks.com/product/pricing/data-transfer-connectivity), or contact your Databricks account team.
